description: This file defines the class AndroidSdkNotConfiguredNotificationProvider, which provides notifications within an IDE when the Android SDK is not configured for a module. It includes logic to create notification panels and handle user actions to open project structure settings.

classes.name: AndroidSdkNotConfiguredNotificationProvider
classes.description: Provides IDE notifications when Android SDK is not configured for a module, creating notification panels and handling user actions.

classes.name: MySdkNotConfiguredNotificationPanel
classes.description: Inner class extending EditorNotificationPanel, displays message about missing or corrupted Android SDK and provides action to open project structure.

methods.name: AndroidSdkNotConfiguredNotificationProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing project and notifications references.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the unique key for this notification type.

methods.name: createNotificationPanel
methods.description: Creates a notification panel if the file is an XML manifest and the SDK is not configured.

methods.name: isResourceFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a resource directory associated with the Android facet.

methods.name: MySdkNotConfiguredNotificationPanel
methods.description: Constructor setting notification text and action label to open project structure.
